scope: 328 finite Linux x86_64 pthread backend only; not a self-review of 324 or general thread/lifetime kernels
source_review: pthread_create is C i32(ptr,ptr,ptr,ptr); pthread_join is i32(i64,ptr); pthread_t has separate 8-byte aligned storage on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; other targets and incompatible existing declarations close generation.

Private helper context is {i32 argument,i32 result}, both initialized before create. Child only receives its stable pointer, reads argument, calls the verified static worker, writes its independent result field, then returns null.

Parent body uses the existing closure by-pointer/by-value ABI and real remaining-ownership drop. Create failure drops prepared body without calling it or loading/joining an uninitialized handle; result is false/0/0.

Success consumes/drops parent body, joins the actual created handle, then reads child result. Failed join calls abort followed by unreachable; context never returns while quiescence is unproved. POSIX create/join provide publication/completion HB; no invented source noalias or Transfer fact.

Private helper/start references remain co-located; static worker edge is included in CGU selection and layout cache input. Machine item hashing binds helper/worker code to object-cache identity; -pthread is emitted only when WithScopedThread is present in LIR.
